ui.tz_milestone_guide: Timezone & conversion (UTC{tz_str}): Slider adjusts display timezone; shifting UTC may move a merchant into the previous or next day.
ui.time_machine_guide: 🕰️ Time Machine: Shift days backward or forward on the slider to inspect past or future data/predictions, compare history, and simulate scenarios. View-only; source data is untouched.
ui.tz_rule_first: 04:00 VN base: prefers actual data, checks phase flow & k*119 + p*j (j ∈ ±6, ±12) / k*119 + jitter across k, p; on gaps 16 / 116 / 132 or cycle 1072 uses k*116 + p*16 across k, p to match phase, filling gaps forward if missing.
ui.tz_rule_mid: Defaults to 119 rhythm (k*119 + jitter); when gap is 16 / 116 / 132 or hits cycle 1072 (14-step pattern), uses k*116 + p*16 across k, p to shift into the matching Phase A (A4 / A3).
ui.tz_rule_last: Wraps along 119 rhythm (k*119 + jitter); on gaps 16 / 116 / 132 or cycle 1072 (k*116 + p*16 across k, p), favors adjusted phase A2 / C7 and falls back when data is missing.
